card.name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
rules:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

card.name: Sacred Ash
rules: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.

card.name: Sacred Charm
rules: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

card.name: Salvatore
rules: Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card on a Pokémon you put down when you were setting up to play or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

card.name: Scoop Up Cyclone
rules: Put 1 of your Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

card.name: Scramble Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon.

card.name: Secret Box
rules:
You can use this card only if you discard 3 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for an Item card, a Pokémon Tool card, a Supporter card, and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Sparkling Crystal
rules: When the Tera Pokémon this card is attached to uses an attack, that attack costs 1 Energy less. (The Energy can be of any type.)

card.name: Special Red Card
rules:
You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.

card.name: Spikemuth Gym
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.

card.name: Strange Timepiece
rules: Devolve 1 of your evolved {P} Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can't evolve this turn.)

card.name: Super Potion
rules: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard an Energy from that Pokémon.

card.name: Surfer
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

card.name: Surfing Beach
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may switch their Active {W} Pokémon with 1 of their Benched {W} Pokémon.

card.name: Survival Brace
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. Then, discard this card.

card.name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

card.name: TM Machine
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon Tool cards that have "Technical Machine" in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Tarragon
rules: Put up to 4 in any combination of {F} Pokémon and Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Team Rocket's Archer
rules:
You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards.

card.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead.

card.name: Team Rocket's Bother-Bot
rules: Turn 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards face up and choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card. You may have your opponent switch those cards. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.)

card.name: Team Rocket's Factory
rules: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards.

card.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
rules: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

card.name: Team Rocket's Great Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Team Rocket's Hypnotizer
rules: If the Team Rocket's Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket's Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.

card.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
rules: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Team Rocket's Proton
rules:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
rules: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Team Rocket's Venture Bomb
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on your Active Pokémon.

card.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
rules: {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

card.name: Technical Machine: Fluorite

attacks.name: Fluorite
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and heal all damage from each of your Tera Pokémon.

rules: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

card.name: Tera Orb
rules: Search your deck for a Tera Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Thick Scale
rules: The {N} Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's {G}, {R}, {W}, or {L} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

card.name: Tool Scrapper
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.

card.name: Transformation Tome
rules:
You must play 2 Transformation Tome cards at once. (This effect works one time for 2 cards.)

Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

card.name: Treasure Tracker
rules: Search your deck for up to 5 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Tremendous Bomb
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to isn't a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, is in the Active Spot, and takes 240 or more damage from an attack from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card.

card.name: Tyme
rules: Tell your opponent the name of a Pokémon in your hand and put that Pokémon face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses that Pokémon's HP, and then you reveal it. If your opponent guessed right, they draw 4 cards. If they guessed wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then, return the Pokémon to your hand.

card.name: Ultra Ball
rules:
You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

card.name: Unfair Stamp
rules:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.

card.name: Urbain
rules: Draw 3 cards.

card.name: Waitress
rules: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

card.name: Wally's Compassion
rules: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.

card.name: Wondrous Patch
rules: Attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.

card.name: Xerosic's Machinations
rules: Your opponent discards cards from their hand until they have 3 cards in their hand.
